selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main comparison made at the beginning of the marked passage?
questions.answer: It compares a hidden, enormous tree with the whole created order and uses that comparison to explain how the Qur’an describes creation.

questions.question: Why is the tree described as hidden from sight?
questions.answer: To prepare the reader for the idea that something unseen can still be known truly by its accurate description.

questions.question: What would make a drawing of the hidden tree convincing?
questions.answer: The drawing would need to show each part in the right place, shape, and proportion from one end of the tree to the other.

questions.question: In the passage, what is being “pictured” in a similar way to the hidden tree?
questions.answer: The whole structure and reality of creation.

questions.question: What “tree” does the passage say the Qur’an describes?
questions.answer: The tree of creation, meaning the entire order of created existence.

questions.question: What ranges of existence are brought together to show the Qur’an’s broad vision?
questions.answer: Time, place, and size are all covered, from the first stage of the world to the hereafter and from tiny particles to the sun.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Qur’an’s presentation of these truths?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an presents them in a fully harmonious, fitting, and consistent way.

questions.question: What conclusion have careful scholars reached after studying these descriptions?
questions.answer: They conclude that the Qur’an reveals astonishing wisdom and unlocks the meaning of the universe.

questions.question: What human explanation for the Qur’an does the passage reject?
questions.answer: It rejects the idea that it came from limited human knowledge.

questions.question: What final truth is reinforced by the verse about the Book containing no crookedness?
questions.answer: That the Qur’an is perfectly straight, reliable, and free from inconsistency.

questions.question: What picture does the passage ask the reader to imagine first?
questions.answer: A huge and extraordinary tree hidden behind a covering so that it cannot be seen directly.

questions.question: Why is a tree a fitting symbol in this passage?
questions.answer: Because a tree has many parts that depend on one another and form one organized whole.

questions.question: Why would a correct picture of the unseen tree remove doubt?
questions.answer: Because such accuracy would be impossible without true knowledge of what lies behind the veil.

questions.question: What does this example help us understand about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that the Qur’an describes unseen and vast realities with precise truth.

questions.question: What does the phrase about contingent beings point to in simple terms?
questions.answer: It points to all created things that exist by Allah’s will.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by calling the universe a riddle or sealed mystery?
questions.answer: It means the universe is difficult to understand on its own, and the Qur’an explains its meaning and order.

questions.question: What feature of the Qur’an’s description especially impresses scholars?
questions.answer: The exact proportion and suitability it preserves between all parts of reality.

questions.question: Why do scholars praise Allah after examining the Qur’an’s depictions?
questions.answer: Because they see that its descriptions are full of wisdom, accuracy, and beauty.

questions.question: What kind of people especially confirm this truth?
questions.answer: Those who have insight into realities and deeper wisdom.

questions.question: How do wise people respond to this kind of presentation?
questions.answer: They praise Allah and affirm that the Qur’an’s account is true and fitting.

questions.question: What kind of object is used as a symbol for understanding the rest of the marked passage?
questions.answer: A hidden tree with many connected parts.

questions.question: What details of the tree must match for the picture to be believable?
questions.answer: Its branches, fruits, leaves, blossoms, and their overall proportions must all fit together properly.

questions.question: What would be impressive about someone drawing that tree correctly on top of the veil?
questions.answer: The person would be showing exact knowledge of something not directly visible.

questions.question: How is this linked to the Qur’an in the next paragraph?
questions.answer: The passage says the Qur’an does the same with the whole of created reality.

title: Description of Creation's Reality Through the Tree Parable
